capabilities.name: Engine Package Map and Governance
capabilities.description: Define named first-class engine boundaries, package ownership, public contracts, private implementations, design records, and lifecycle governance.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.1 Engine package map governance and design records
capabilities.notes: Named engines include document layout, calculation, code/task, geometry, rendering, physics/simulation, timeline, media, game runtime, workflow, indexing, and assets/dependencies.

capabilities.name: Versioned Engine Contracts
capabilities.description: Define engine versioning, compatibility, deprecation, backend selection, ownership, migration, experimental-status rules, and extension surfaces.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.1 Engine package map governance and design records
capabilities.notes: Backends must remain replaceable behind PL-owned contracts.

capabilities.name: Engine Execution Boundaries
capabilities.description: Define CPU, GPU, worker, memory, serialization, cancellation, scheduling, thread-safety, precision, and update-loop boundaries.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.2 CPU GPU worker memory and update-loop contracts
capabilities.notes: Expensive engine work must not block Electron renderer interaction.

capabilities.name: Typed Resource and Dependency Graph
capabilities.description: Represent source, embedded, linked, generated, cached, stale, missing, derived, shared, and external resources with stable dependency tracking.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.3 Typed asset dependency scene and spatial foundation
capabilities.notes: Existing asset services provide a partial foundation but not the complete typed resource graph.

capabilities.name: Shared Scene and Spatial Foundation
capabilities.description: Provide stable IDs, hierarchy, transforms, layers, visibility, bounds, spatial queries, references, and migration-safe serialization.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.3 Typed asset dependency scene and spatial foundation
capabilities.notes: The Modeling Engine provides a partial scene foundation that must become shared and contract-driven.

capabilities.name: Engine Cache and Invalidation
capabilities.description: Provide content hashing, cache invalidation, incremental rebuilds, stale detection, and safe derived-resource cleanup.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.3 Typed asset dependency scene and spatial foundation

capabilities.name: Engine Benchmark Laboratory
capabilities.description: Provide fixed benchmark fixtures and repeatable benchmark execution for documents, workbooks, repositories, scenes, timelines, media, games, workflows, and simulations.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.4 Benchmark laboratory and profiling dashboards
capabilities.notes: Benchmarks must establish workload targets and regression thresholds.

capabilities.name: Engine Profiling and Trace Capture
capabilities.description: Collect frame, calculation, memory, allocation, worker, GPU, import/export, build, render, simulation, and cache metrics.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.4 Benchmark laboratory and profiling dashboards

capabilities.name: Engine Fault Injection
capabilities.description: Test worker crashes, device loss, malformed assets, partial writes, invalid schemas, bad extensions, failed imports, and interrupted jobs.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.5 Failure isolation fault injection and recovery contracts
capabilities.notes: Faults must produce visible errors and must not silently corrupt projects.

capabilities.name: Engine Recovery and Fallback
capabilities.description: Provide safe cleanup, recovery actions, safe-mode entry points, and fallback backends when supported engine operations fail.
capabilities.source: v1.6 — Wave 1.6.5 Failure isolation fault injection and recovery contracts
capabilities.notes: Engine incidents should integrate with Command Center diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Production Geometry and Modeling Engine
capabilities.description: Provide topology representation, robust selection, transforms, snapping, normals, topology editing, modifiers, booleans, validation, undo integration, and cancellable geometry jobs.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.1 Geometry and modeling engine
capabilities.notes: A real Modeling Engine foundation exists but the Official-v1 geometry engine is substantially broader.

capabilities.name: Rendering Material Lighting and GPU Engine
capabilities.description: Provide cameras, materials, textures, lighting, shadows, picking, overlays, gizmos, render targets, capture, post-processing hooks, GPU resource management, culling, batching, and profiling.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.2 Rendering materials lighting and GPU resources
capabilities.notes: Existing Three.js rendering is a real foundation but not yet the complete production rendering contract.

capabilities.name: Timeline and Animation Engine
capabilities.description: Provide tracks, clips, layers, keyframes, curves, interpolation, markers, ranges, playback clocks, retiming, blending, and serialization.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.3 Timeline animation and media computation
capabilities.notes: The Stage 4 Movie Engine provides an initial timeline/playback/keyframe foundation.

capabilities.name: Media and Compositing Engine
capabilities.description: Provide audio/video timing, caches, proxies, waveforms, effects, masks, blend modes, compositing primitives, synchronization, diagnostics, and render jobs.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.3 Timeline animation and media computation
capabilities.notes: Current movie-engine work provides part of the timing/playback foundation; production media computation remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Game Runtime and Build Engine
capabilities.description: Provide scene lifecycle, entity/component runtime, scripts, events, input, physics binding, animation states, UI, audio, navigation, save/load, testing, profiling, and build contracts.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.4 Game runtime and build engine
capabilities.notes: A real runtime controller and entity/component foundation exists, but the production runtime target is much broader.

capabilities.name: Document Layout Engine
capabilities.description: Provide structured rich text, pagination, styles, tables, floating objects, references, review state, printing, and PDF layout contracts.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.5 Document layout and spreadsheet calculation engines

capabilities.name: Spreadsheet Calculation Engine
capabilities.description: Provide formula parsing, typed values, dependency graphs, incremental and background recalculation, dynamic arrays, errors, auditing, and function conformance.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.5 Document layout and spreadsheet calculation engines

capabilities.name: Code Intelligence and Task Runtime
capabilities.description: Provide engine-level integration for language servers, terminals, tasks, builds, diagnostics, tests, Git, and safe process execution.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.6 Code intelligence workflow indexing and plugin runtime

capabilities.name: Workflow Execution Engine
capabilities.description: Provide typed workflow inputs and outputs, cancellation, rollback, dry runs, retries, logs, resource locks, and execution records.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.6 Code intelligence workflow indexing and plugin runtime

capabilities.name: Indexing and Search Engine
capabilities.description: Provide incremental indexing and search for large projects, extension content, cross-slice references, and changing project resources.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.6 Code intelligence workflow indexing and plugin runtime

capabilities.name: Engine Plugin Runtime Boundaries
capabilities.description: Provide controlled engine and platform runtime boundaries that later extension SDKs and marketplace products can consume safely.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.6 Code intelligence workflow indexing and plugin runtime

capabilities.name: All-Engine Integration and Contention Testing
capabilities.description: Run all engines inside one reference project and measure contention, memory pressure, worker scheduling, GPU use, cache behavior, and recovery.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.7 All-engine integration and slice-entry freeze
capabilities.notes: This is the primary proof that separately working engines also coexist as one suite.

capabilities.name: Slice-Entry Engine Contract Freeze
capabilities.description: Freeze the versioned engine contracts required by the six slice build-outs while permitting backward-compatible implementation improvements.
capabilities.source: v1.7 — Wave 1.7.7 All-engine integration and slice-entry freeze
capabilities.notes: Architecture manuals, capability matrices, benchmarks, licenses, fallback paths, and known limitations must be published at this gate.
